name: Marvin
summary:
Marvin is Tianji Intelligent's family of human-like force-controlled arms and dual-arm manipulation systems. Seven-axis arm configurations include joint torque sensing and interfaces for grippers, dexterous hands and other end effectors. Different arm variants provide different reach and payload combinations for research and industrial integration.

The Marvin Pro arrangement places two arms on a fixed support with cameras, compute and ROS 2 support for perception, control and data collection. This entry describes the family rather than a single mobile humanoid: the chosen arm model and system
